say:1:1710236001:1.text: Rowan, is this your stall? My apologies, I didn't mean to damage the target—
say:1:1710236001:1.source_cn: 罗万，这是你的摊位？抱歉，我不是要故意破坏箭靶——

say:2:1710236002:1.text: Don't worry about it! I should be thanking you for making that target look so good with your incredible shot!
say:2:1710236002:1.source_cn: 破坏？不不不，格温妮丝，你刚才那一箭简直太精彩了！

say:3:1710236003:1.text: You hit the bullseye from so far off, took down that rogue monkey...
say:3:1710236003:1.source_cn: 百步之外，一箭正中靶心！而且还顺便制服了那只捣乱的猴子！

say:4:1710236004:1.text: And even managed to retrieve the handbag.
say:4:1710236004:1.source_cn: 嗯，除此之外，还找回了赃物。

say:5:1710236005:1.text: ... It was just a lucky shot.

say:8:1710236007:1.text: Thanks for the compliment. Have we... met before?
say:8:1710236007:1.source_cn: 谢谢您的夸奖，您……认识我？
say:8:1710236007:1.male: Thanks for the compliment. Have we... met before?
say:8:1710236007:1.female: Thanks for the compliment. Have we... met before?

say:9:1710236008:1.text: This is Magister Merlin. He's here for the Ascension Festival by Peggy's invitation.
say:9:1710236008:1.male: This is Magister Merlin. He's here for the Ascension Festival by Peggy's invitation.
say:9:1710236008:1.female: This is Magister Merlin. She's here for the Ascension Festival by Peggy's invitation.

say:10:1710236009:1.text: Are you... the legendary Magister Merlin who sealed the Hypofiends and kept our empire safe twenty years ago?!
say:10:1710236009:1.source_cn: 梅……林？难道……是那位20年前封印了魔物、拯救了耀光...
say:10:1710236009:1.male: Are you... the legendary Magister Merlin who sealed the Hypofiends and kept our empire safe twenty years ago?!
say:10:1710236009:1.female: Are you... the legendary Magister Merlin who sealed the Hypofiends and kept our empire safe twenty years ago?!

say:11:1710236010:1.text: Gwyneth becomes flustered in an instant. She tries to give a proper salute, but her nerves make her arm stiff.
say:11:1710236010:1.source_cn: 你看到她瞬间变得手足无措，下意识地想要行一个最标准的军...
say:11:1710236010:1.male: Gwyneth becomes flustered in an instant. She tries to give a proper salute, but her nerves make her arm stiff.
say:11:1710236010:1.female: Gwyneth becomes flustered in an instant. She tries to give a proper salute, but her nerves make her arm stiff.

say:12:1710236011:0.text: Greetings! M-My name is Gwyneth, a-a member of the Royal Guard!
say:12:1710236011:0.source_cn: 阁下！我名为格温妮丝，是皇家守备军的一员！
say:12:1710236011:0.male: Greetings! M-My name is Gwyneth, a-a member of the Royal Guard!
say:12:1710236011:0.female: Greetings! M-My name is Gwyneth, a-a member of the Royal Guard!

say:13:1710236012:1.text: I spent my childhood listening to stories about you!
say:13:1710236012:1.source_cn: 我从小就是听着您的传说长大的！
say:13:1710236012:1.male: I spent my childhood listening to stories about you!
say:13:1710236012:1.female: I spent my childhood listening to stories about you!

say:14:1710236013:1.text: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!
say:14:1710236013:1.source_cn: ……失礼了！您刚才的夸奖……是我的荣幸！
say:14:1710236013:1.male: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!
say:14:1710236013:1.female: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!

choice_prompt:15:1710236013.text: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!
choice_prompt:15:1710236013.source_cn: ……失礼了！您刚才的夸奖……是我的荣幸！
choice_prompt:15:1710236013.male: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!
choice_prompt:15:1710236013.female: ... Please forgive my rudeness just now! Your compliment's a great honor!

say:16:1710236014:1.source_cn: 怎么会是夸张！阁下，您太谦虚了！

say:18:1710236018:1.text: I knew you were good with a bow from Peggy, but seeing you in action today proves she wasn't exaggerating!
say:18:1710236018:1.source_cn: 不过说真的，我之前听佩吉提起过格温妮丝你的箭术很厉害，...

say:19:1710236019:1.text: By the way, hitting the bullseye wins you the grand prize in our game—a limited-edition drake toy!
say:19:1710236019:1.source_cn: 说到这个，按照我们游戏的规则，射中10环的人有资格获得...

say:21:1710236021:1.text: That's right! This is the #002 secret toy, and its wings can move!
say:21:1710236021:1.source_cn: 没错，这可是编号为002的神秘隐藏款，翅膀还能动呢！

say:23:1710236022:1.text: Gwyneth instinctively takes a small step forward before forcing herself to stop. She clears her throat.
say:23:1710236022:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝下意识地向前迈了半步，但又立刻强行克制住自己，...

say:24:1710236023:1.text: Um... I can't accept such a valuable gift.
say:24:1710236023:1.source_cn: 这、这个……我不能收这么贵重的礼物。

say:25:1710236024:1.text: I was just doing my job, not playing the game.
say:25:1710236024:1.source_cn: 我只是在执行公务，不是在玩游戏。

choice_prompt:26:1710236024.text: I was just doing my job, not playing the game.
choice_prompt:26:1710236024.source_cn: 我只是在执行公务，不是在玩游戏。

say:27:1710236025:1.source_cn: 没错，格温妮丝，这是你应得的。

say:28:1710236026:1.text: Without waiting for Gwyneth's reply, Rowan shoves the toy along with the box into her arms. Gwyneth stiffens, but still holds it close.
say:28:1710236026:1.source_cn: 罗万不由分说地将限量龙玩偶连同盒子塞进了她的怀里。 她...

say:30:1710236028:1.text: You're blushing! Looks like you really are a fan of my toys! When there's a new release, I'll have Peggy—
say:30:1710236028:1.source_cn: 格温妮丝，你脸红了！既然你喜欢，下次有新款的话，我让佩吉——

say:31:1710236029:1.text: Y-You've got it wrong! I just find them... well-made! Yeah, that's it!
say:31:1710236029:1.source_cn: 我、我才没有！我、我只是觉得……做工不错！对，做工！

say:32:1710236030:1.text: Ah! The parade's about to begin! I've got to go.
say:32:1710236030:1.source_cn: 啊！时间差不多了，我得走了。

say:33:1710236031:1.text: I must leave now, or I'll be late!
say:33:1710236031:1.source_cn: 军事献演马上开始，我不能迟到。大魔法师阁下，罗万，告辞了！
say:33:1710236031:1.male: I must leave now, or I'll be late!
say:33:1710236031:1.female: I must leave now, or I'll be late!

say:35:1710236032:1.text: Clutching the box to her chest, Gwyneth darts into the crowd, almost as if she is trying to escape.
say:35:1710236032:1.source_cn: 她紧紧抱着宝盒，几乎是逃跑似的，飞快地挤进了人群中。

say:36:1710236033:1.text: Wow, she slipped away so fast! So she wasn't really held up by the crowd just now…
say:36:1710236033:1.source_cn: 诶！一口气说完，又快速从这么多人中溜走了，刚刚是怎么被...

choice_prompt:37:1710236033.text: Wow, she slipped away so fast! So she wasn't really held up by the crowd just now…
choice_prompt:37:1710236033.source_cn: 诶！一口气说完，又快速从这么多人中溜走了，刚刚是怎么被困住的啊……

say:38:1710236034:1.text: Nah, I watch it every year. I don't mind skipping it this time.
say:38:1710236034:1.source_cn: 我每年都看，早就看腻了。

say:39:1710236035:1.text: And... um... I've been so caught up in my toy business lately, so I haven't seen Peggy in a long time.
say:39:1710236035:1.source_cn: 而且……那个……我、我最近沉迷研发新玩偶，好久没见佩吉了。

say:40:1710236036:1.text: I really don't want to run into her there... I'm better off just staying here and making money!
say:40:1710236036:1.source_cn: 我可不想被她抓到……还是守着我的摊位赚钱比较自在！

choice:37:0:1.text: I'm going to watch the parade. You coming?
choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 我也要去看军事献演了，你不一起吗？
choice:37:0:1.male: I'm going to watch the parade. You coming?
choice:37:0:1.female: I'm going to watch the parade. You coming?

choice:15:0:1.text: I'm not as great as the legends make me out to be.
choice:15:0:1.male: I'm not as great as the legends make me out to be.
choice:15:0:1.female: I'm not as great as the legends make me out to be.

say:43:1710236015:1.source_cn: 是！阁下！认识您是我的荣幸！

choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 很高兴认识你，格温妮丝

say:44:1710236016:1.text: Sorry! I didn't mean for it to come out that way...
say:44:1710236016:1.male: Sorry! I didn't mean for it to come out that way...
say:44:1710236016:1.female: Sorry! I didn't mean for it to come out that way...

say:45:1710236017:1.text: Haha, stop teasing Gwyneth already! She takes everything seriously and is a dedicated captain of the Royal Guard!
say:45:1710236017:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，你就别逗格温妮丝啦。格温妮丝可是赛凡纳最认真的...
say:45:1710236017:1.male: Haha, stop teasing Gwyneth already! She takes everything seriously and is a dedicated captain of the Royal Guard!
say:45:1710236017:1.female: Haha, stop teasing Gwyneth already! She takes everything seriously and is a dedicated captain of the Royal Guard!
